newsitem.title: USA: N.Y. Gov. wants to drop Lieutenat Gov. from ticket.
newsitem.headline: N.Y. Gov. wants to drop Lieutenat Gov. from ticket.

text.p: New York Gov. George Pataki, who has seen his Liuetenant Governor push bills backed by his Democrat opponents, said Thursday he planned to run for re-election with another nominee for Lieutenant Governor.

"Unfortunately, you have demonstrated through your decisions that you do not share my vision for this state. Your unwillingness and, in fact, outright refusal to work as part of our united team to build on these historic achievements has been disappointing," Pataki wrote to current Lieutenant Gov. Betsy McCaughey Ross.
